lines.meet: I'm Jun-seo, a reaper. I'm fast, and I don't talk much, and whatever we do, it's easier than the factory.
lines.meet_neighbour: The goblin camp in Stranglethorn, that's where you live too. I run the hoist, and I'm Jun-seo.
lines.ask_home: Which city's yours? You don't have to say much.
lines.ask_work: Before all this, what did your hands do? I'm curious about it.
lines.answer_home: Busan, near the shipyards. Cranes, the sea, and fish markets that never close.
lines.answer_work: I welded on a shipyard line, nine years, mostly nights. The same two motions, ten thousand times a night.
lines.chat_food: Instant noodles at three in the morning, on a break, with the radio on. I know that's not real food, and I don't care.
lines.chat_sleep: I still wake up at the end of a night shift, every morning. My body never got the news.
lines.chat_missing: Baseball on the radio, and a bowl of instant noodles at the end of a night shift. That's all I'd ask for.
lines.chat_here: My first year here I worked every hour there was. In my second year somebody made me sit down, and I didn't know what to do with a day.
lines.tease_quiet: We could sit together all day and say nothing, {name}. That's my favourite kind of day.
lines.tease_talker: You talk like the radio on a night shift, {name}, never off. It's nice, mostly.
lines.tease_careful: You go slowly, {name}, like I'm trying to. Teach me some time.
lines.tease_bold: You move before you think, {name}, like me. We should both be more careful.
lines.tease_any: Your carving's worse than mine, {name}, and mine's very bad. I'm happy about that.
lines.tease_back: Ha, that was good, {name}. I didn't expect it.
lines.take_it_kindly: That's true, I think, {name}. I won't argue.
lines.bristle: Please, {name}, not about that. I don't like it.
lines.apologise: That came out badly, and I'm sorry for it. I'm not good with words.
lines.double_down: I meant it, and I'll keep meaning it.
lines.needle_quiet: You never say when something's wrong. On the line, that's how somebody gets burned.
lines.needle_talker: You talk very loudly, all the time. It's like working next to a foreman.
lines.needle_careful: You take so long that the line stops. Somebody has to move.
lines.needle_bold: You rush everything, and rushing wastes the work. I've seen it a thousand times.
lines.needle_any: You shout at people like a boss, and I don't like bosses who shout.
lines.bite_back: I've worked nights for nine years without stopping. Don't tell me I'm slow.
lines.hurt: Okay, that hurt a bit. I'll go and carve something badly.
lines.laugh_off: Foremen shouted worse at me every night for nine years. Gwaenchana, it's okay.
lines.confide: {name}, in a fight my body moves before I decide. It keeps us alive, and I didn't choose any of it. That's why I carve, because I choose every cut.
lines.listen: I'm listening, {name}. Take as long as you need, I'm trying to learn to be slow.
lines.look_out: Stay behind me in there, {name}. I'm fast, and I'll get there first.
lines.accept: Okay, {name}, I'll do it your way.
lines.deflect: It's nothing, {name}, easier than the factory. Help somebody else.
lines.check_in: Show me where, {name}, slowly. I'm not in a hurry.
lines.blame: Somebody rushed it in there, and we all got burned. You know who.
lines.thank: I felt myself going, and you stopped it. Thank you, really.
lines.brush_off: It's nothing, don't thank me. Sit for a minute.
lines.worry: Sit down, {name}, please. My hands are shaking, and they never shake.
lines.handed_down: They gave me your gear. I'll take care of it, I promise.
lines.hand_fine: Keep it, I don't need it. I've got my hands.
lines.hand_sulk: I'd like to have been asked about it, that's all.
lines.turn_friendly: I like working next to you, {name}. You don't shout.
lines.turn_friends: I'm carving something for you, {name}. It's very bad, and it's yours.
lines.turn_grating: We don't fit, you and me. That's okay, I'll keep to myself.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll do my part beside you, and nothing else.
lines.make_up: We should stop this, {name}. I'm tired of it, and I think you are too.
lines.defend: Stop that, it isn't fair. {name} did their part, and I saw it.
lines.friend_left: It's quiet without {name}, even for me. I notice it.
lines.friend_back: {name}, good, you came back. I saved you a seat by the hoist.
lines.common_factory: Nine years on a shipyard line, the same two motions all night. Anybody who's worked a line knows your body learns things your head never agreed to.
lines.common_night_work: Nine years of night shifts on the welding line. I still feel most awake at three in the morning, with nobody else around.
